title: Smoked Salmon Tikka Masala
description: A twist on the classic Indian dish, with the addition of smoky salmon. This recipe is perfect for a special occasion or a romantic dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, garam masala, and salt.
Add the salmon fillet to the marinade and coat evenly.
Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the salmon from the marinade and brush with grill oil.
Grill the salmon for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the salmon to a baking sheet and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes.
While the salmon is cooking, heat butter in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, grated ginger, and diced tomato.
Cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add masala powder and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the cooked salmon and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the Smoked Salmon Tikka Masala hot, garnished with fresh cilantro.
